scope: Methods-only synthetic; no source data, no ecological score, no EOG-WF endpoint change (3/31/3).

constraints.source: fixed; interventions never delete source or evaluated targets

graph_generator.algorithm: Python random.Random; per system/world draw integer env 0..3 at all 20 states in time then site order; iterate all ordered pairs (time/site lexicographic); if 1<=dt<=2 and rng.random()<0.40, draw barrier randint(0,2) then hard rng.random()<0.10; keep edge iff not hard, abs(site difference)<=2*dt, abs(env difference)<=2, barrier<=1; distance=abs(site difference); same-site edge explicit.

estimands.reach: exact-time reachable states per world; no demographic occupancy/persistence inference
estimands.possible: union of entire world-specific reached sets
estimands.robust: intersection of entire world-specific reached sets
estimands.loss: baseline minus post-removal reached sets; possible loss and robust loss calculated AFTER world-level propagation
estimands.site_critical: target initially reachable but disappears after all time copies of site removed; no individually critical intermediate state of same site = time-flexible necessity (intermediate state removal comparison includes all site copies at times 1..3; target/source distinct)
estimands.conditional_all_world_site_critical: nonempty set of baseline supporting worlds; all supporting worlds lose target under site removal, even if others were initially unreachable; distinct from all-world initial reachability

comparators: independent state knockouts as proxy for persistent site knockouts

canonical.time_flexible: same world contains two disjoint internal paths: 00->11->32->43 and 00->21->33->43; every path visits site1, neither (1,1) nor (2,1) indispensable
canonical.across_worlds: one path per world from corrected time_flexible witness; robust target reachable, no shared complete path; persistent site1 removal removes target from every world
canonical.splice: world1 has 00->21 only; world2 21->43 only; neither reaches 43; union edges incorrectly reaches it
canonical.no_support: neither world supports target; conditional necessity must be false

oracle: DP propagation vs independent DFS enumerating all path prefixes for each world and intervention; independently derive aggregate masks and target necessity from baseline enumerated paths. Test all 15 interventions (none+12 state+2 site) x 320 worlds = 4800 DP/DFS comparisons; 160 x 15 x 2 projection comparisons = 4800; report all denominators and failures.
success: all four witnesses; zero oracle mismatches, zero deletion-monotonicity failures; no required positive stress frequency; preserve null/adverse counts.
stop: finite synthetic graph, no continuous space certificate; do not infer biological movement or conservation effect; no production API or endpoint change.
pre_score_correction: Correct second witness 30 to 33 because 30->43 violates the frozen speed bound. No random or canonical evaluation yet. All thresholds, generator and estimands unchanged.
